description: Details for one destination: its name and codes, region, how many eSIM plans are sold there, the cheapest and most expensive, the smallest and largest data bundles, and its storefront page. Takes a country name ("Japan") or two-letter code ("JP"). Use this to describe a destination before pulling its full plan ladder with list-plans. Whether a plan can be topped up varies by plan and is reported by list-plans, not here.

currency.description: Three-letter currency code for the prices (e.g. "USD", "EUR"). Defaults to EUR.

destination.description: The destination: a country name ("Japan") or a two-letter code ("JP").

name: get-destination-info

currency.description: ISO 4217 code every amount below is quoted in, e.g. "EUR".

iso2.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, e.g. "JP". This is the code list-plans and plan-trip take.

path.description: Path on the storefront, e.g. "/esim/spain/". Always the canonical page, never a redirect.

query.description: Query parameters that belong on the path, as an object. Empty when there are none.

url.description: The full storefront URL for this country's storefront page. Safe to show to a person.

note.description: How to read the numbers above, and what to call next.

count.description: How many plans are sold for this destination.

largest_bundle_mb.description: Largest metered allowance in megabytes, on the same terms.

lowest_price_cents.description: Cheapest plan, in minor units (cents), so 1250 is 12.50.

smallest_bundle_mb.description: Smallest metered allowance in megabytes. Unlimited plans store 0 MB and are counted in the price range and the plan count but not here, so this is 0 when every plan is unlimited.

region.description: The region this country is filed under, e.g. "Asia". Null when it is filed under none.

title: Get destination info
